title: Introducing the new Copilot: Home, Code and Autopilot
summary: Microsoft reorganized Copilot around four surfaces — Home, Code, Autopilot and Today — with Office apps built in. Rolling out through the Frontier program in the coming weeks.

title: Evolving the Copilot pricing model with FinOps for AI
summary: Everyday AI stays on the flat per-user license. Cowork, Code, Autopilot and frontier models move to usage-based Copilot Credits, gated behind an admin-configured spending policy.
